open_questions: The Gold Account documents never mention whether paper statements are available or what they cost. Silver Plus says only Green savings requires paperless, so this workflow assumes Gold allows paper at no stated fee. Confirm this.

A worked example under this workflow: a deposit below $10,000 in a Gold Account, with a Silver Rewards Card (+0.2%), earns 5.7% minus $120 a year in maintenance fees. That still beats Silver Plus Tier 1 (3.0% + 0.15%). The Green Account + Silver Rewards Card pair (4.45%, no fee) would earn more, but Green requires paperless statements.
The 0.025% relationship bonus on Silver and Silver Plus applies 'when you qualify under the relationship criteria', but no document defines those criteria.
The Gold Account doc gives an example of 5.5% + 0.025% = 6.0%, which is arithmetically inconsistent. Use 5.525% only if the customer holds a Gold Rewards Card.
'Green Rewards Card' appears in the savings APY bonus tables, but only a business Green Rewards Card is documented. Do not recommend it for a personal customer.
No document says whether the agent can submit a personal credit card application. The workflow has the customer use their own apply_for_credit_card tool.
